name: Blackrock Stronghold
summary: Blackrock Stronghold is a heavily fortified encampment carved into the crags of the northern Burning Steppes, positioned right outside the entrance to Blackrock Mountain. It serves as a major field garrison for the Blackrock orcs and their allies under the Dark Horde banner.

sections.title: Garrison of the Dark Horde
sections.body: Sprawling across the scorched foothills below Blackrock Mountain, the stronghold functions as the primary ground base for the Blackrock clan in the Burning Steppes. Unlike Thrall's Horde, these orcs cling to their warlike legacy, serving Rend Blackhand and the dragonkin who lurk above in the spire.

sections.title: Front Line of Blackrock Spire
sections.body: The stronghold serves as both an outer defense and a staging ground for attacks into the Redridge Mountains and neighboring human lands. The fortress maintains a constant watch over the southern approaches to the mountain, challenging anyone who dares traverse the blasted wastes.

faq.answer: It is a fortified military base situated in the northern Burning Steppes just outside Blackrock Mountain, serving as an outer garrison for the Blackrock clan of orcs.

faq.q: Are the orcs here friendly to Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: No. The orcs of Blackrock Stronghold belong to the Dark Horde, led by Rend Blackhand. They reject Thrall's leadership and are hostile to both the Alliance and the new Horde.

angles.text: For Thrall's Horde, the Blackrock clan represents the shameful legacy of the Old Horde—bloodthirsty, corrupted remnants who refuse honor and peace.
The stronghold is a grim reminder of the Second War, situated within striking distance of the Kingdom of Stormwind's northern borders.
